name: TNF receptor associated factor 2
pathways: positive regulation of JUN kinase activity

function.text: TRAF2 encodes TNF receptor-associated factor 2. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and signaling adaptor activity. It participates in positive regulation of JUN kinase activity and signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
